ruling.recommended_action: Issue a $4.47 voucher refund to the rider (NS-7) for the unexempted off-route distance on the RydeTAXI meter; the metered waiting units of $1.08 stand.

segment_findings.reason: The rider's only pre-segment message asked for "a 7-Eleven on the way" without naming any place [F9], and the driver's reply "Ok" named no road, area or store [F10]; a reply that agrees only to 'a stop' cannot be consent to an unnamed route, so RD-5 does not exempt the segment, and the complete timestamped record [F11] leaves no timing/meaning question to call undetermined. Under RD-3(b) a stop requested without a named place does not excuse the driver's unilateral choice of a far branch, which the driver's own statement confirms ("I went to the one I know" [F12]); extra kilometres and distance from the optimal route are not evidence of a different destination [F4]. The segment's 3.17 extra km are therefore refundable under RD-2.

rejected_claims.reason: Timing is not in dispute — the rider's message was sent at 17:33 before the 17:37 segment start [F9][F10][F4] — but timing alone does not create consent: the rider agreed only to 'a stop' and the driver named no road or store, so there is no agreed route for RD-5 to exempt [F9][F10][RD-5].

RD-3(b) is the opposite of the driver's reading: where the rider names no location and the driver picks a stop that produces an off-route segment without prior notice of the place, the extra_km is not excused [F9][F12][F4][RD-3(b)]. The stationary point F2 sits 5306 m from pickup and 4755 m from drop-off, so the store was not on the optimal route [F2].

The driver's own arithmetic concedes the ceiling; the 0.63 km residual between the billed 3.8 km excess and the segment's 3.17 km is a mapping residual outside the unexempted segment and is not refundable under RD-2, so the refund is the segment figure alone [F1][F4][F5][RD-2].

This is conceded by the rider and not pressed: the 4 min 10 s standstill was the rider-requested stop and metered waiting units of $1.08 (4.2 min × $0.26/min) are chargeable on RydeTAXI, so the waiting item stands [F2][F6][RD-3(c)].

The absence of incidents [F15] and the band-4 records [F13][F14] do not exempt the segment: band data alone cannot excuse a reroute and there is no qualifying incident on the replaced stretch, so RD-4 gives the driver nothing and the rider's excess-distance narrative is unrebutted [F15][F13][F14][RD-4].

Withdrawn by the rider and confirmed by the record: route_disputes_upheld_90d = 0 [F18], so the repeated-breach limb of RD-6 is absent and no flag_account is added; profile facts cannot themselves establish the route breach [F18][RD-6].

Accepted as to quantum only: 3.17 km × $1.41/km = $4.47 [F4][F5][F8][RD-2]. It does not disturb the finding that the segment counts, since the rider's agreement covers a stop and no named route [F9][F10][RD-5].
